title: Amit Shah to hold crucial meeting on border security and other issues
summary: Home Minister Amit Shah will meet with the Parliamentary Committee today, which includes discussions on border security. The committee also meets with the Ministry of Defence. This event matters as it shows the government's focus on national security.
summary_points: Amit Shah to hold meeting with the Parliamentary Committee
Discussion on border security and other issues
Meeting with the Ministry of Defence included
